title: Harvest/Postharvest Deviations & Quality Response
level: Cultivation Technician II / advanced occupational pathway
intendedAudience: Learners who have completed or can demonstrate the Technician I prerequisite pathway
Cultivation technicians developing supervised troubleshooting, verification, reconciliation, and peer-support capability
prerequisites: THC Cultivation Technician I pathway or approved equivalent prerequisite evidence
evidencePolicy: Use canonical evidence-backed science and operational references for durable principles. Facility SOPs, labels, equipment manuals, validated sensor procedures, and jurisdiction-specific requirements control when more specific. Reused modules are development dependencies and do not substitute for course-specific occupational review.
assessmentPolicy: This draft course shell is not credential evidence merely because its structure exists. Dedicated instruction, formative work, course-level summative assessment where applicable, human technical review, accessibility review, and mapped performance evidence must be completed and validated before release.
description: Develops postharvest deviation containment, drying/process trend interpretation, representative product measurement, lot genealogy and affected-scope reasoning, controlled-deviation review, and QA-ready handoff without conferring product release or disposition authority.
learningOutcomes: Contain postharvest deviations and establish a fact/timeline baseline before causal or disposition conclusions.
Interpret room/process history together with representative product measurements while distinguishing room RH, moisture content and water activity.
Reconstruct lot genealogy and affected scope without unsupported facility-wide expansion or convenient exclusions.
Produce a QA-ready handoff while preserving controlled records, historical SOP versions and product-disposition authority boundaries.
